independentSourceFindings.summary:
Source review holds Renon A04 versus older Xcellent Plus ratings, HUSKY 2 discharge-current revisions, ETHOS expansion-kit versus complete-system ratings, SOK generation and temperature inconsistencies, and unavailable exact variants. Victron used-unit hardware revisions, Wagan and Whistler voltage conflicts, SunGoldPower SG-C versus older SG-2P breakers, and unselected fuse/bundle options remain explicit holds. Accessible exact Enphase, LG, Briggs and Wagan documents restored published operating, performance, test and thermal conditions.

Connector fit is separate from supplied conductor size; component busbar, diode, fuse, enclosure and breaker ratings retain their own scope. Stäubli current revisions, IronRidge conductor-range revisions and QuickCable length differences remain unresolved. A QuickCable stud-size follow-up transcription error was corrected in the review record. Expansion-port ratings are not battery continuous-current ratings or expansion capacity; recommended PV oversizing is not the device maximum utilized input. Apparent VA, timed discharge, undefined HIC applicability and unsupported port or capacity units remain distinct. Physical stacking statements preserve separately purchased bases, installation restrictions and exact host alternatives without inferring electrical parallel connections.

Normalization preserves every original value and qualifier, actual source attribution and exact identity. A fastener tool-drive size is excluded from the electrical connector field; mixed voltage/frequency occurrences retain only missing projections while recording existing verified projections as held. Missing fields are imported only through the unchanged guards, with explicit checks that previously rendered comparison values and every prior verified field object remain intact.

The refreshed capture newly truncates the FlexBOSS18 record, so its researched facts are excluded from this batch. Four previously verified Victron busbar identities also differ from current metadata and remain held; prior evidence is retained without automatic rebinding.

formattingReview.scope: Only source-backed missing fields through unchanged runtime; review of scratch normalization and actual importer, rendering, and connection-limit consumers.

findings.reason: A fastener/tool drive identifies the installation tool, not an electrical connector or terminal. Parser acceptance cannot establish equivalence.

findings.requestedDisposition: Hold recommended PV sizing guidance separately; retain the source-qualified actual utilized maximum without interpreting the recommendation as an operating limit.

findings.reason: The unchanged broad expansion-label regex accepts battery-to-host port input/output current under Expansion / parallel connection. The first BP1000X aggregation additionally discarded direction labels, leaving only 36 A; 65 A.
findings.requestedDisposition: Hold electrical expansion-port statements as unsupported. Do not infer expansion quantity, standalone-load capability, or continuous discharge duty.

findings.reason: Each normalized voltage-plus-frequency occurrence adds frequency, but the importer retains an existing voltage field with a different source/value. Thus the full retained candidate mapping does not survive integration despite each standalone row parsing successfully.
findings.requestedDisposition: Hold the whole compound occurrence, or explicitly retain only source-published frequency with complete original conditions while auditing the voltage as a prior-evidence hold. Preserve prior objects.

engineeringConclusions: A parsed field is insufficient proof of semantic equivalence; mechanical drive and expansion-port examples require holds despite acceptance by broad existing labels.
Active watts and apparent VA remain distinct. Retained active-W rows may carry full same-document VA statements as labeled context, without converting VA to W.
Source conditions, durations, temperature qualifications, nominal versus usable energy, module/system/pack scope, and AC/DC direction must remain attached to the displayed value.
Numeric-first formatting is acceptable only for an explicitly published measurement and must retain the complete original label/value. It cannot calculate or infer ratings.

Exact source URL, kind, selected identities and source metadata must survive. Multiple records from the same document may combine full values with original metadata retained in the occurrence audit; different documents are not interchangeable.
Original and candidate importer/identity/correction/quarantine guards remain authoritative. Existing verified field objects and identity anchors are immutable.

Actual comparisonRows rendering must be exercised because adding qualified voltage/capacity can disable scalar-derived energy. Holding such a row is preferable to stripping conditions or synthesizing energy.
The connection-map parser rejects qualified limits as non-scalar. Retaining conditions deliberately preserves uncertainty and does not authorize inferred numeric compatibility.
formattingReview.finalVerdict: Pass for the exact hash-bound normalized output and fresh readable catalog scope. All four review findings are resolved. All 848 approved original occurrences reconstruct, all 602 retained rows fill previously unverified fields and survive final import with identical values, source kinds and URLs, prior verified field objects and identities remain unchanged, and no previously rendered comparison value or usable connection limit is lost. Unsupported meanings, source conflicts, identity/capture failures and partial prior projections remain explicit holds; no runtime or canonical modifications were made by this reviewer.
